fullPassage: In online discussion forums, people interact by posting messages at different times, as opposed to discussing the topic in real time. Each new message they post addresses one that was added earlier, and in this way the discussion progresses. The main advantage of these forums is that people can contribute to the discussion whenever they have enough time. Some of these contributions are simple comments, while others might be questions, responses, or even challenges. The individual messages don't need to be long or include a lot of detail in order for the discussion to remain active. The downside is that this level of activity is unlikely to remain steady. As a result, discussions taking place in an online forum format may last for an unnaturally long time, and some of the messages may ultimately end up being ignored.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) interact 소통하다 (B) progresses 진행되다 (C) contribute 기여하다
det.analysis:

❌ ③ interact(소통하다) - declines(감소하다) - hesitate(망설이다): (B)(C) 토론이 '진행되고' 사람들이 '기여하는' 것
❌ ④ compete(경쟁하다) - declines(감소하다) - contribute(기여하다): (A)(B) 오류
det.tip: interact=소통하다(syn: communicate), progresses=진행되다(ant: declines), contribute=기여하다(ant: hesitate)

det.korean: downside 단점: 상황의 부정적인 측면 또는 불리함
det.analysis:
✅ ① downside(단점): 상황의 부정적 측면이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ← 정답
❌ ② outcome(결과): 긍정/부정 모두 가능한 결과
❌ ③ challenge(도전): 어려움이지 단점 자체는 아님
❌ ④ feature(특징): 중립적 특징으로 부정적 의미 없음
det.tip: downside=단점. 'the downside is that ~' 패턴으로 단점 서술

questions.passage: Some of these contributions are simple comments, while others might be questions, responses, or even __________. (challenge) The individual messages don't need to be long or include a lot of detail in order for the discussion to __________ (remain) active.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: challenge → challenges: 복수형. questions, responses와 병렬 구조
det.analysis: 괄호 안 challenge를 알맞은 형태로: questions, responses, or even _____ 에서 병렬 구조상 복수형 challenges가 적절
det.tip: or even challenges: 병렬 구조에서 앞의 questions, responses와 같은 복수형

questions.passage: In online discussion forums, people interact by __________ (post) messages at different times, as opposed to __________ (discuss) the topic in real time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: post → posting: 전치사 by 뒤 동명사
det.analysis: by __________ (post) messages: 전치사 by 뒤에 동명사가 와야 하므로 posting. as opposed to __________ (discuss)도 동명사 discussing이 답이지만 첫 번째 빈칸이 주 정답
det.tip: by + -ing: 수단/방법 표현. by posting = 올림으로써

questions.passage: In online discussion forums, people interact by posting messages at different times, as opposed to discussing the topic __________. Each new message they post addresses one that was added earlier, and in this way the discussion progresses. The main advantage of these forums is that people can contribute to the discussion whenever they have enough time. Some of these contributions are simple comments, while others might be questions, responses, or even challenges. The individual messages don't need to be long or include a lot of detail in order for the discussion to remain active. The downside is that this level of activity is unlikely to remain steady. As a result, discussions taking place in an online forum format may last for an unnaturally long time, and some of the messages may ultimately end up being ignored.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: in real time 실시간으로: 실시간 토론에 '반대되는' 방식
det.analysis:
❌ ① in a formal manner(격식 있는 방식으로): 격식과 무관
❌ ② at a later date(나중에): 시간 차이 아닌 '실시간' 대비
✅ ③ in real time(실시간으로): 서로 다른 시간에 메시지를 올리는 것과 '실시간' 토론이 대비 ← 정답
❌ ④ in written form(서면으로): 글로 된 형식은 이미 포럼 자체
det.tip: as opposed to ~: ~에 반대되는. 비동기(different times) vs 동기(real time) 대비

questions.passage: In online discussion forums, people interact by posting messages at different times, as opposed to discussing the topic in real time. Each new message they post addresses one that was added earlier, and in this way the discussion progresses. The main advantage of these forums is that people can contribute to the discussion whenever they have enough time. Some of these contributions are simple comments, while others might be questions, responses, or even challenges. The individual messages don't need to be long or include a lot of detail in order for the discussion to remain active. The downside is that this level of activity is unlikely to remain steady. As a result, discussions taking place in an online forum format may last for an unnaturally long time, and some of the messages may ultimately __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: end up being ignored 결국 무시되다: 토론이 부자연스럽게 오래 지속되면서 일부 메시지가 결국 무시됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① remain popular for years(수년간 인기를 유지하다): 단점을 서술하는 맥락에 부적절
✅ ② end up being ignored(결국 무시되다): 비꾸준한 활동의 결과로 메시지가 무시됨 ← 정답
❌ ③ gain more attention over time(시간이 지나면서 관심을 얻다): 무시되는 것과 반대
❌ ④ become increasingly relevant(점점 더 관련성이 높아지다): 단점 맥락과 모순
det.tip: end up -ing=결국 ~하게 되다. downside 이후 부정적 결과 서술
